comments.author: lukel97
comments.body:
It turns out that the FIXME that ce3648094d44e8c098396a353b215acecb363cda set out to wasn't actually an issue at all. I had forgotten that we don't store a V0Def on every instruction, just the ones that use V0, so it ended up sometimes clearing V0Defs on instructions that do use V0. I've reverted said commit and added the test case for this. 

And whilst fixing that, a separate -verify-machineinstrs failure fell out so that was also fixed in b71d88ca5bf42533b822be782ed9066e68011e95
